task_description: Handle expired/missing Riot API key gracefully. The Riot API returns 401 (key expired). GitHub Issue #21 already exists with correct content. The API route already handles 401/403 from Riot, but needs to also handle the case where RIOT_API_KEY env var is not set (which throws RiotApiError with status 500). Fix the route to catch this case and return the same user-friendly 503 message.
